section.trust.title: Built on trust and safety
section.trust.body: Verified badges are only shown when an administrator has reviewed evidence. Suspicious jobs and accounts can be reported, and personal location is never shown precisely to other users.
section.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.1.q: Do I need a certificate or degree?
faq.1.a: No. You can list practical skills and experience. Employers who need a specific qualification will say so in the job post.
faq.2.a: Creating a worker profile and applying for jobs is planned to be free. Employer pricing has not been decided.
faq.3.q: How does the AI decide who matches?
faq.3.a: It scores skills (including related skills and meaning of descriptions), experience, location, qualifications, availability and pay, then shows the breakdown. It assists decisions; it never hires or rejects anyone.
faq.4.a: The interface is being prepared for English, Amharic and Afaan Oromo. Some screens are still English only.
faq.5.a: We collect only what is needed, hide phone numbers and exact location from people you have not interacted with, and let you control profile visibility.
